mapper.insert: INSERT INTO training_material_upload(id, owner_id, title, material_type, object_key, page_count, expires_at) VALUES(#{id}, #{owner}, #{title}, #{type}, #{key}, #{pages}, #{expires})
mapper.select: SELECT id, owner_id AS owner, title, material_type AS type, object_key AS `key`, page_count AS pages, expires_at AS expires FROM training_material_upload WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id FROM training_material_upload WHERE expires_at <= #{now} ORDER BY expires_at LIMIT 100
